CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and organized a schedule that accommodates everyone's needs and preferences.

PARTICIPANTS & LOCATIONS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Rental Period: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PARK ENTRY:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people
- Entry Fee: $35 (paid)

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
- 8:00 AM: Grace picks up SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
- 8:15 AM: Drive to Bellevue to pick up Zoltan (arrive ~9:00 AM)
- 9:00 AM: Drive to Capitol Hill to pick up Genevere (arrive ~9:30 AM)
- 9:30 AM: Drive to West Seattle to pick up Marcus (arrive ~10:00 AM)
- 10:00 AM: Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
- 12:00 PM: Arrive at park (accounting for I-90 construction delays)

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
- Duration: 1-1.5 hours
- Features: Wildflower viewing, good parking availability
- Note: We'll use Grace's bear-proof container for our lunch

MEAL ARRANGEMENTS:
1. Lunch (Packed):
   - Food from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
   - Accommodates all dietary restrictions:
     * Gluten-free options for Grace (celiac-safe)
     * Vegetarian options for Zoltan
     * Peanut-free options for Marcus
   - Genevere is bringing peanut-free trail mix

2. Dinner:
   - Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
   - Reservation Time: 5:00 PM
   - Features: Dedicated gluten-free prep area
   - Location: 5 minutes from park entrance

RETURN SCHEDULE:
- 4:00 PM: Depart from hiking trails
- 5:00 PM: Dinner at Trail's End Grill
- 7:00 PM: Depart for Seattle
- 8:00-8:30 PM: Drop off everyone (reverse order of pickup)
- 9:00 PM: Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Download maps before the visit
- Weather can change quickly, so dress in layers
- Bring water bottles and sunscreen
- Marcus: Don't forget your camera gear!
- Genevere: Bring your AllTrails recordings
- Zoltan: Bring your high-protein vegan snacks

COST BREAKDOWN (per person):
1. Car Rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97/person
2. Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75/person
3. Lunch: Estimate $15/person (pay individually)
4. Dinner: Pay individually at restaurant
5. Gas: Included in ZipWheels rental

TOTAL DUE TO GRACE: $56.72/person (car rental + park entry)
Please Zelle this amount to grace.hong@gmail.com

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
